description: 16 modular software-engineering Agent Skills for project discovery, architecture, development, testing, security and documentation.

skills.description: Perform rigorous code reviews and security assessments covering correctness, architecture, authorization, data integrity, vulnerabilities, performance and maintainability. Use before merging or releasing changes.

skills.description: Design, implement, migrate and optimize relational, document and cache data systems, including PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Prisma, Drizzle and SQL tooling.

skills.description: Design, build, secure, test and operate C#/.NET applications, including ASP.NET Core APIs, MVC, Blazor, EF Core, authentication, authorization, background services and observability. Use for new or existing .NET projects.

skills.description: Build secure, maintainable Electron desktop applications with safe process boundaries, IPC, packaging, auto-update strategy and cross-platform testing.
skills.name: electron-development

skills.description: Plan, build, test and ship maintainable Flutter applications for mobile, web or desktop with appropriate state management, navigation, data and platform integration.

skills.description: Design and implement reliable Go APIs, workers and services with idiomatic packages, concurrency, persistence, testing and observability.
skills.name: go-backend-development

skills.description: Build, secure, test and deploy Laravel applications using PHP, Eloquent, queues, caching, authentication, authorization, APIs and the Laravel ecosystem. Use for new or existing Laravel projects.

skills.description: Produce accurate Markdown project documentation, architecture records, setup guides, API references, operational runbooks and final handover reports.

skills.description: Create risk-based test strategies and execute unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, regression, accessibility, security and performance testing for software projects.
skills.name: testing-quality-assurance
